definition: Prospects (identified leads) created from 2024-01-01 until the data end (2026-01-01, exclusive).
Share of leads that place a first order within 60 days of lead creation, among leads with a complete 60-day window (all channels).

Conversion rate of the top 10% of open leads ranked by the champion lead score (logistic_regression) divided by the average rate. Conversion = first order within 30 days of a monthly scoring run; out-of-time holdout runs 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-01.
Holdout ROC AUC of the champion lead score (logistic_regression); 0.5 is random ranking. Interval: clustered bootstrap.
Share of the 17,004 leads created 2024-03-04 to 2025-02-01 (exclusive) who reach purchase within 30 days of lead creation.
Session funnel step (prospect sessions, 2024-03-04 to 2025-03-03) where the most sessions are lost.

One-page checkout minus control in first-purchase conversion (2025-03-03 to 2025-05-25; 2,886 treatment vs 2,888 control prospects). Decision: Do not ship as tested: conversion improved, but at least one guardrail did not pass. Fix the cause and re-test.
Relative change in average first-order net value, one-page checkout vs control (guardrail; fails if the decline is worse than 5.0%). Status: fail.
Share of active customers (ordered in the 180 days before a monthly run) who place no order in the next 90 days. Holdout runs 2025-07-01 to 2025-10-01.
Holdout ROC AUC of the champion churn model (gradient_boosting). Interval: clustered bootstrap.

Holdout net margin per monthly run from offering a retention voucher only to customers with a positive expected value (53.4% of the active base). Assumes a 15.0% save rate and $10.00 incentive; ROI 1.12×.
Sum of order net amounts (after discounts) from 2024-01-01 until the data end (2026-01-01, exclusive).
Mean net amount per order over the same period.
Share of net revenue from orders other than a customer's first.
Share of next-180-day revenue generated by the 10% of customers with the highest predicted value (bgnbd_gamma_gamma); holdout run 2025-07-01. A random 10% captures 10%.

Holdout net value (incremental margin minus cost) of offering the growth perk to customers whose predicted incremental margin covers its cost (1,190 customers). Assumes a 5.0% revenue uplift; break-even uplift 2.6%.
New customer buys again within the new window: share of new customers who order again (become active or loyal) rather than slipping to at risk, 2024-12 to 2025-12. Interval: Wilson 95%.
Share of customers in the Loyal state at the end of 2025-12: Ordered within the last 90 days, at least 6 orders in the last 365 days and first order more than 180 days ago.
At-risk customer returns before churning: share of at-risk customers who order again (return to active or loyal) rather than churning, 2024-12 to 2025-12. Interval: Wilson 95%.
Share of all customers ever acquired who are churned at the end of 2025-12: Last order more than 180 days ago.
Champion model (harmonic) forecast of net revenue for the 13 weeks from 2025-12-29 to 2026-03-29, with its 80% empirical prediction interval.
Weighted absolute percentage error of the champion over the rolling-origin evaluation backtest (all lead weeks). Naive 4-week run rate: 13.3%.
